name: CTOS
recent: CTOS Digital 在 2026 年 11 月初发生网络安全事件后已全面恢复信用报告服务，但媒体报道指出成本上升可能影响前景。同期，公司主要股东（EPF、Aberdeen 系、KWAP）连续多日申报持股变动。最新季度（2026-09-30）营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: 公司信用报告服务在网络安全事件后已全面恢复。
最新季度（2026-09-30）营收同比增长 10.8%，净利同比增长 30.2%。
主要股东 EPF、Aberdeen 系及 KWAP 在 11 月连续多日申报持股变动。
risks: 媒体报道指出成本上升可能影响公司前景。
公司发生网络安全事件，服务一度中断。
主要股东在 11 月多个交易日申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026-09-30 季度营收为 MYR 87.567M，环比增长 0.8%，同比增长 10.8%；净利为 MYR 27.543M，环比增长 21.6%，同比增长 30.2%；净利率为 31.5%，高于上一季度的 26.1%。

recent_en: CTOS Digital fully restored credit reporting services after a cybersecurity breach in early November 2026, while media reports flagged higher costs affecting the outlook. Meanwhile, major shareholders (EPF, Aberdeen entities, KWAP) filed continuous changes in shareholdings. The latest quarter (2026-09-30) saw revenue and net profit grow year-on-year.
notable_en: The company's credit reporting services were fully restored after a cybersecurity breach.
Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 10.8% YoY and net profit grew 30.2% YoY.
Major shareholders EPF, Aberdeen entities and KWAP filed continuous changes in shareholdings in November.
risks_en: Media reports noted higher costs may affect the company's outlook.
The company experienced a cybersecurity breach that temporarily disrupted services.
Major shareholders filed changes in shareholdings on multiple trading days in November.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-09-30, revenue was MYR 87.567M, up 0.8% QoQ and 10.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 27.543M, up 21.6% QoQ and 30.2% YoY; net margin was 31.5%, higher than 26.1% in the previous quarter.
